en.s: The Battle of Dadosesani Land (German: Bitwa na ziemi Dziadoszan; German: Schlacht im Land der Dadosanen), also known as the Battle of Dadosesani Forest (Polish: Bitwa w Lesie Dziadoszan, Bitwa w Lesie Dziadoszyców; German: Schlacht von Dadosaner-Wälder) was fought on 1 September 1015 during the Polish–German Wars, between the forces of the Holy Roman Empire, led by emperor Henry II, the margrave of the Saxon Eastern March, against the forces of the Duchy of Poland led by duke Bolesław I the Brave and Mieszko II Lambert.

zh.s: 达多萨尼地区战役又称达多萨尼森林战役，于1015年9月1日在波德战争期间爆发。神圣罗马帝国军队由皇帝亨利二世和萨克森东部边疆区的藩侯率领，迎战波兰公国军队；后者由勇敢者博莱斯瓦夫一世公爵和梅什科二世·兰贝特率领。该战役的德语名称包括Bitwa na ziemi Dziadoszan和Schlacht im Land der Dadosanen，另一个波兰语名称为Bitwa w Lesie Dziadoszan或Bitwa w Lesie Dziadoszyców，德语另称Schlacht von Dadosaner-Wälder。

en.s: The Battle of Atapuerca was fought on 1 September 1054 at the site of Piedrahita ("standing stone") in the valley of Atapuerca between two brothers, King García Sánchez III of Navarre and King Ferdinand I of Castile. The Castilians won and King García and his favourite Fortún Sánchez were killed in battle. Ferdinand reannexed Navarrese territory he conceded to García 17 years earlier after his brother's assistance at Pisuerga.

zh.s: 1054年9月1日，纳瓦拉国王加西亚·桑切斯三世与卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南一世这对兄弟，在阿塔普埃尔卡河谷的皮耶德拉伊塔（意为“立石”）交战。卡斯蒂利亚军获胜，加西亚国王及其亲信福尔图恩·桑切斯阵亡。17年前，斐迪南曾因兄长在皮苏埃尔加的援助而把纳瓦拉领土让给加西亚；这次斐迪南重新兼并了这些领土。

en.t: The main altar of Lund Cathedral, at the time the seat of the archiepiscopal see of all the Nordic countries, is consecrated
en.s: Lund Cathedral (Swedish: Lunds domkyrka) is a cathedral of the Lutheran Church of Sweden in Lund, Scania, Sweden. It is the seat of the Bishop of Lund and the main church of the Diocese of Lund. It was built as the Catholic cathedral of the archiepiscopal see of all the Nordic countries, dedicated to Saint Lawrence. It is one of the oldest stone buildings still in use in Sweden.

zh.t: 隆德大教堂主祭坛祝圣
zh.s: 隆德大教堂（瑞典语：Lunds domkyrka）是瑞典斯科讷省隆德的一座瑞典信义会主教座堂，也是隆德主教驻地和隆德教区的主教座堂。它最初是北欧各国大主教驻地的天主教主教座堂，奉圣劳伦斯为主保圣人。它是瑞典仍在使用的最古老石质建筑之一。

en.s: The Battle of Wiłkomierz (see other names) took place on September 1, 1435, near Ukmergė in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. With the help of military units from the Kingdom of Poland, the forces of Grand Duke Sigismund Kęstutaitis soundly defeated Švitrigaila and his Livonian allies. The battle was a decisive engagement of the Lithuanian Civil War (1432–1438).

zh.s: 维尔科梅日战役于1435年9月1日在立陶宛大公国的乌克梅尔盖附近发生。在波兰王国军队的支援下，大公西吉斯蒙德·科斯图泰提斯的部队大败什维特里盖拉及其利沃尼亚盟友。这是1432至1438年立陶宛内战中的一场决定性战役。

en.s: The Tumu Crisis, also known as the Crisis of the Tumu Fortress, or the Jisi Incident, was a border conflict between the Oirat Mongols and the Ming dynasty of China. In July 1449, Esen Taishi, leader of the Oirat Mongols, launched a large-scale, three-pronged invasion of China. Despite having capable generals, Emperor Yingzong of Ming, under the influence of eunuch Wang Zhen who dominated the Ming court at the time, made the decision to personally lead his armies into battle against Esen.

zh.s: 土木堡之变又称土木堡危机或己巳之变，是瓦剌蒙古与中国明朝之间的一场边境冲突。1449年7月，瓦剌首领也先太师兵分三路，大举入侵明朝。尽管朝中有能干的将领，明英宗在当时主宰朝政的宦官王振影响下，仍决定亲自率军与也先交战。

en.s: The Attack on Modon was a military expedition by the Knights Hospitallers to capture the city of Modon held by the Ottomans. Initially, the knights managed to capture the city, but the citadel held out, and an Ottoman relief force arrived, forcing the knights to retreat.

zh.s: 医院骑士团曾远征攻取由奥斯曼人控制的莫东城。骑士团起初成功占领了城市，但城堡仍在抵抗，随后奥斯曼援军赶到，迫使骑士团撤退。

en.s: The sack of Mahón occurred in 1535, when Hayreddin Barbarossa attacked the harbour of Mahón in the Balearic Islands. The expedition followed closely the defeat of Barbarossa in the Conquest of Tunis by Charles V. Barbarossa had escaped Tunis and boarded his fleet in Bône. Mahón had no garrison, only one or two cannons and no ammunition or gunpowder stored.

zh.s: 1535年，海雷丁·巴巴罗萨袭击了巴利阿里群岛马翁港，劫掠马翁。此次远征紧随查理五世在突尼斯征服战争中击败巴巴罗萨之后。巴巴罗萨逃离突尼斯后，在博讷登上舰队。马翁没有驻军，只有一两门火炮，也没有储备弹药或火药。

en.s: The Battle of Flores was a naval engagement during the Brittany Campaign of the Anglo-Spanish War of 1585 fought off the Island of Flores between an English fleet of 22 ships under Lord Thomas Howard and a Spanish fleet of 55 ships under Alonso de Bazán.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 弗洛雷斯海战是1585年英西战争布列塔尼战役期间的一场海战，发生在弗洛雷斯岛近海。托马斯·霍华德勋爵率领22艘船组成的英国舰队，与阿隆索·德·巴桑率领的55艘船组成的西班牙舰队交战。

en.s: The siege of Kottakkal also known as the battle of Cunhale River (batalha do rio do Cunhale in Portuguese) was a military engagement between the joint forces of the Portuguese Empire and the Zamorin of Calicut against the stronghold of Kunjali Marakkar (Cunhale in Portuguese) Kottakkal called by the Portuguese Forte Branco ("White Fort").
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科塔卡尔围城战又称昆哈莱河战役（葡萄牙语：batalha do rio do Cunhale），是葡萄牙帝国与卡利卡特扎莫林联合进攻昆贾利·马拉卡尔的据点科塔卡尔的一场战斗。葡萄牙人称该据点为Forte Branco（“白堡”）；昆贾利·马拉卡尔在葡萄牙语中称作Cunhale。

en.t: Claudio Monteverdi's musical work Vespro della Beata Vergine (Vespers for the Blessed Virgin) is first published, printed in Venice and dedicated to Pope Paul V
en.s: Vespro della Beata Vergine (Vespers for the Blessed Virgin), SV 206, is a musical setting by Claudio Monteverdi of the evening vespers on Marian feasts, scored for soloists, choirs, and orchestra. It is an ambitious work in scope and in its variety of style and scoring, and has a duration of around 90 minutes.

zh.t: 克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第的《圣母晚祷》首次出版
zh.s: 《圣母晚祷》（Vespro della Beata Vergine，作品目录号SV 206）是克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第为圣母节日的晚祷仪式创作的一部音乐作品，由独唱者、合唱团和管弦乐队演出。这部作品规模宏大，风格和编制多样，演出时长约90分钟。

en.s: The Battle of Castelnaudary occurred at Castelnaudary, France, on 1 September 1632, between the rebel forces of Henri II de Montmorency (loyal to Gaston, Duke of Orléans) and the royalist forces of Marshal Henri de Schomberg (loyal to King Louis XIII).

zh.s: 卡斯泰尔诺达里战役于1632年9月1日在法国卡斯泰尔诺达里发生。交战双方是效忠奥尔良公爵加斯东的叛军，由亨利二世·德·蒙莫朗西率领；以及效忠路易十三国王的王军，由亨利·德·朔姆贝格元帅率领。

en.s: The Capture of Roermond was a minor siege during the Eighty Years' War which took place from 31 August to 1 September 1637. A Spanish army under Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand would successfully siege and seize Roermond from the Dutch just one week after his victory at Venlo. This siege battle and that of Venlo were originally targeted to draw Frederick Henry away from Berda and towards the Cardinal-Infante's army for what could have been a field battle.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 鲁尔蒙德陷落是八十年战争期间的一场小规模围城战，发生于1637年8月31日至9月1日。由红衣主教—王子费迪南德率领的西班牙军队成功围攻并从荷兰人手中夺取了鲁尔蒙德；就在一周前，他刚在芬洛获胜。芬洛和鲁尔蒙德两场围城战原本都是为了把腓特烈·亨利从布雷达引开，诱使他转向红衣主教—王子的军队，进而与其进行野战。
zh.n: 本条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Tippermuir (also known as the Battle of Tibbermuir or Battle of Tibbermore) (1 September 1644) was the first battle James Graham, 1st Marquis of Montrose, fought for King Charles I in the Scottish theatre of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. During the battle, Montrose's Royalist forces routed an army of the Covenanter-dominated Scottish government under John Wemyss, Lord Elcho.

zh.s: 蒂珀缪尔战役又称蒂伯缪尔战役或蒂伯莫尔战役，于1644年9月1日打响，是詹姆斯·格雷厄姆（第一代蒙特罗斯侯爵）在三王国战争苏格兰战场上为查理一世作战时参加的首场战役。战斗中，蒙特罗斯的保王军击溃了由约翰·威姆斯勋爵（埃尔乔勋爵）率领、以圣约派为主的苏格兰政府军。

en.s: The siege of Hereford took place in 1645 during the English Civil War when the city of Hereford and its English Royalist garrison was besieged by a Scottish Covenanter army under the command of the Earl of Leven. The Covenanters were allied to the English Parliamentarian cause and moved to take the Royalist stronghold in the wake of their victory at the Battle of Naseby.
en.n: English Civil War: Scottish Covenanter forces abandon their month-long Siege of Hereford, a Cavalier stronghold, on news of Royalist victories in Scotland.

zh.s: 赫里福德围城战发生于1645年英国内战期间。莱文伯爵率领的苏格兰圣约派军队围困赫里福德城及驻守当地的英国保王派部队。圣约派支持英国议会派，在纳斯比战役获胜后转而进攻这座保王派据点。
zh.n: 英国内战：苏格兰圣约派军队在得知保王派于苏格兰获胜后，放弃了对保王派据点赫里福德为期一个月的围攻。

en.s: The siege of Dundee, 23 August to 1 September 1651, took place during the 1650 to 1652 Anglo-Scottish war. After a two-day artillery bombardment, a Covenanter garrison under Robert Lumsden surrendered to Commonwealth of England forces commanded by George Monck. Shortly afterwards, Aberdeen also surrendered, effectively ending resistance in Scotland, while Oliver Cromwell's victory at Worcester concluded the Wars of the Three Kingdoms.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 邓迪围城战于1651年8月23日至9月1日在1650至1652年的英苏战争期间进行。经过两天炮击后，罗伯特·卢姆斯登率领的圣约派守军向乔治·蒙克指挥的英格兰共和国军队投降。不久之后，阿伯丁也投降，苏格兰的抵抗实际上就此结束；与此同时，奥利弗·克伦威尔在伍斯特获胜，结束了三王国战争。

en.s: The Battle of Chiari was fought on 1 September 1701 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement was part of Prince Eugene of Savoy's campaign to seize the Spanish controlled Duchy of Milan in the Italian peninsula, and had followed his victory over Marshal Catinat at the Battle of Carpi in July. Marshal Villeroi replaced Catinat as commander of the Franco–Spanish–Savoyard forces in the theatre, carrying with him orders from King Louis XIV to push the Imperialists out of Italy. Foreseeing Villeroi's intention of attacking at any price, Eugene entrenched himself in front of the small fortress of Chiari, and waited for the attack.

zh.s: 基亚里战役于1701年9月1日西班牙王位继承战争期间进行，是萨伏依亲王欧根在意大利半岛夺取西班牙控制的米兰公国战役的一部分。此前，欧根已于7月在卡尔皮战役中击败卡蒂纳元帅。维勒鲁瓦元帅接替卡蒂纳，指挥当地的法西萨联军，并奉路易十四之命将帝国军逐出意大利。欧根预料维勒鲁瓦不惜一切代价进攻，于是在基亚里小要塞前筑垒，等待法军来攻。

en.t: At the age of five, Louis XV becomes king of France in succession to his great-grandfather, King Louis XIV
en.s: Louis XV (15 February 1710 – 10 May 1774), known as Louis the Beloved (French: le Bien-Aimé), was King of France from 1 September 1715 until his death in 1774. He succeeded his great-grandfather Louis XIV at the age of five. Until he reached maturity (then defined as his 13th birthday) in 1723, the kingdom was ruled by his grand-uncle Philippe II, Duke of Orléans, as Regent of France.

zh.t: 五岁的路易十五继承曾祖父路易十四，成为法国国王
zh.s: 路易十五（1710年2月15日—1774年5月10日）被称为“受爱戴的路易”（法语：le Bien-Aimé），自1715年9月1日起担任法国国王，直至1774年去世。他五岁时继承曾祖父路易十四的王位。在他于1723年满13岁、达到当时规定的成年年龄之前，法国由其叔祖父奥尔良公爵腓力二世摄政。

en.t: The Mission San Luis Obispo de Tolosa is founded in San Luis Obispo, California
en.s: Mission San Luis Obispo de Tolosa (Spanish: Misión San Luis Obispo de Tolosa) is a Spanish mission founded September 1, 1772 by Father Junípero Serra in San Luis Obispo, California. The mission was named after San Luis, obispo de Tolosa (Saint Louis, bishop of Toulouse, France). The Mission of San Luis Obispo is unusual in its design, in that its combination of belfry and vestibule are found nowhere else among the California missions.

zh.t: 托洛萨圣路易斯奥比斯波传教站建立
zh.s: 托洛萨圣路易斯奥比斯波传教站（西班牙语：Misión San Luis Obispo de Tolosa）是西班牙传教站，由胡尼佩罗·塞拉神父于1772年9月1日在加利福尼亚州圣路易斯奥比斯波建立。传教站以图卢兹主教圣路易斯命名。其设计独特，钟楼与前厅的组合在加利福尼亚其他传教站中都没有出现。

en.s: The Powder Alarm was a major popular reaction to the removal of gunpowder from a gunpowder magazine near Boston by British troops under orders from General Thomas Gage, governor of the Province of Massachusetts Bay, on September 1, 1774. In response to this action, amid false rumors that blood had been shed, alarm spread through the countryside to Connecticut and beyond, and local Patriots formed themselves into armed mobs, fearing that war was at hand.

zh.s: 1774年9月1日，英国军队奉马萨诸塞湾省总督托马斯·盖奇将军之命，从波士顿附近的一处火药库取走火药，引发民众强烈反应。尽管关于流血事件的传言并不属实，恐慌仍从乡间蔓延到康涅狄格及更远地区，当地爱国派因担心战争即将爆发而组成持械民众团体。

en.s: The battle of Graham’s Fort took place on September 1, 1780 between Patriot and Loyalist militias in present day Cleveland County, North Carolina. Colonel William Graham had built a large log cabin near Buffalo Creek, which would eventually be regarded as Graham’s Fort. On September 1, a group of Loyalists approached the building and demanded that Graham surrender himself. Graham refused and the two groups exchanged fire.

zh.s: 1780年9月1日，爱国派民兵与效忠派民兵在北卡罗来纳州今克利夫兰县交战。威廉·格雷厄姆上校此前在布法罗溪附近建造了一座大型原木屋，后来这座屋子被称为格雷厄姆堡。9月1日，一队效忠派来到屋前，要求格雷厄姆投降。他拒绝后，双方交火。

en.s: The 1795 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on September 1, 1795, in order to elect the Governor of Connecticut. Incumbent Federalist Governor of Connecticut Samuel Huntington won re-election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于1795年9月1日举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长塞缪尔·亨廷顿没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: Juno (minor-planet designation: 3 Juno) is a large asteroid in the asteroid belt. Juno was the third asteroid discovered, in 1804, by German astronomer Karl Harding. It is tied with three other asteroids as the thirteenth largest asteroid, and it is one of the two largest stony (S-type) asteroids, along with 15 Eunomia. It is estimated to contain 1% of the total mass of the asteroid belt.

zh.s: 朱诺（小行星编号：3 Juno）是一颗大型小行星，位于小行星带。它于1804年由德国天文学家卡尔·哈丁发现，是第三颗被发现的小行星。在已知小行星中，朱诺与另外三颗并列第13大；它也是最大的两颗石质（S型）小行星之一，另一颗是15号小行星司琴星。据估计，朱诺的质量约占整个小行星带总质量的1%。

en.s: The sinking of HMS Avon was a single ship action fought during the War of 1812, and took place on 1 September 1814. In the battle, the ship-rigged sloop of war USS Wasp forced the Cruizer-class brig-sloop HMS Avon to surrender. The Americans could not take possession of the prize as other British brig-sloops appeared and prepared to engage. Avon sank shortly after the battle.

zh.t: 英国皇家海军阿冯号沉没
zh.s: 阿冯号沉没事件是1812年战争期间的一场单舰战斗，发生于1814年9月1日。战斗中，美国海军战船黄蜂号迫使英国皇家海军克鲁泽级双桅战船阿冯号投降。由于其他英国双桅战船出现并准备交战，美军未能接收这艘战利舰。战斗结束后不久，阿冯号沉没。

en.s: The 1817 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on September 1, 1817, to elect the first Governor of the newly admitted state of Mississippi. Incumbent territorial governor David Holmes ran unopposed, garnering 100% of the vote.

zh.s: 密西西比州于1817年9月1日举行州长选举，选出新加入联邦的该州首任州长。时任领地总督戴维·霍姆斯没有对手，获得100%的选票。

en.s: The Winnebago War, also known as the Winnebago Uprising, was a brief conflict that took place in 1827 in the Upper Mississippi River region of the United States, primarily in what is now the state of Wisconsin. Not quite a war, the hostilities were limited to a few attacks on American civilians by a portion of the Winnebago or Ho-Chunk Native American tribe.

zh.s: 温尼贝戈战争又称温尼贝戈起义，是1827年发生在美国密西西比河上游地区的一场短暂冲突，主要地点在今威斯康星州。严格来说，这并不算一场战争；冲突仅限于温尼贝戈人（又称霍-丘克人）部族中的一部分人对美国平民发动的几次袭击。

en.t: The Order of St. Gregory the Great is established by Pope Gregory XVI of the Vatican State to recognize high support for the Vatican or for the Pope, by a man or a woman, and not necessarily a Roman Catholic
en.s: The Pontifical Equestrian Order of St. Gregory the Great (Latin: Ordo Sancti Gregorii Magni; Italian: Ordine di San Gregorio Magno) was established on 1 September 1831, by Pope Gregory XVI, seven months after his election as Pope. The order is one of the five orders of knighthood of the Holy See.

en.s: The 1835 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on September 1, 1835. Incumbent Anti-Masonic governor William A. Palmer contested the election with Democratic nominee William Czar Bradley and Whig nominee Charles Paine. Since no candidate received a majority in the popular vote, the state constitution required the Vermont General Assembly and Vermont Executive Council to meet in joint convention and elect a governor.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州于1835年9月1日举行州长选举。反共济会党现任州长威廉·A·帕尔默与民主党候选人威廉·蔡尔·布拉德利和辉格党候选人查尔斯·佩恩角逐。由于没有候选人获得普选票过半，州宪法要求佛蒙特州众议院和州行政委员会召开联席会议选出州长。

en.s: The San Felipe incident was the first naval battle fought between Mexican and rebel forces during the Texas Revolution. Thomas McKinney deliberately provoked the Mexican government by heavily arming the merchant ship San Felipe, filling it with a cargo of munitions meant for Texian revolutionaries, and sending it from New Orleans to Brazoria, Texas. Aboard was a crew of Texians and Stephen F. Austin, recently released from incarceration in Mexico and dedicated to Texian independence from Mexico. On September 1, 1835, as the San Felipe was transferring the last of its cargo to the Laura, also crewed by Texians, the Mexican Navy warship Correo de Mejico approached.

zh.s: 圣费利佩号事件是德克萨斯革命期间墨西哥军与叛军之间的首场海战。托马斯·麦金尼故意激怒墨西哥政府：他为商船“圣费利佩号”大量配备武器，装上运给德克萨斯革命者的弹药，再从新奥尔良派船前往德克萨斯州布拉索里亚。船上有一批德克萨斯人船员和刚从墨西哥监狱获释、支持德克萨斯脱离墨西哥独立的斯蒂芬·F·奥斯汀。1835年9月1日，“圣费利佩号”正把最后一批货物转运到同样由德克萨斯人船员驾驶的“劳拉号”时，墨西哥海军军舰“墨西哥信使号”驶近。

en.t: Saint Andrew's Scots School, the oldest school of British origin in South America, is established
en.s: The Saint Andrew's Scots School (Spanish: Escuela Escocesa San Andrés), also referred to as Saint Andrew's, is an Argentine bilingual school in Olivos, Vicente López Partido, Buenos Aires Province. Established in 1838 in downtown Buenos Aires, the school offers early childhood, primary and secondary education and has a university founded in 1988. The school's campus is located in San Fernando, Tigre Partido, inside the urban area known as Greater Buenos Aires.

zh.t: 南美洲最古老的英式学校——圣安德鲁苏格兰学校成立
zh.s: 圣安德鲁苏格兰学校（西班牙语：Escuela Escocesa San Andrés），也称圣安德鲁学校，是阿根廷的一所双语学校，位于布宜诺斯艾利斯省比森特洛佩斯市奥利沃斯。学校于1838年在布宜诺斯艾利斯市中心创办，提供幼儿教育、小学和中学教育，并设有一所创办于1988年的大学。学校校区位于布宜诺斯艾利斯大都会区内的蒂格雷县圣费尔南多市。

en.s: The Venezuelan peasant insurrection of 1846 was a popular and social rebellion that broke out in various agricultural areas of Venezuela in September 1846 and lasted until May 1847. The rebellion was suppressed by the Conservative army. The rebellion took place in the aftermath of the fraudulent 1846 Venezuelan presidential election.

en.s: The Battle of Pima Butte, or the Battle of Maricopa Wells, was fought on September 1, 1857 at Pima Butte, Arizona near Maricopa Wells in the Sierra Estrella. Yuma, Mohave, Apache and Yavapai warriors attacked a Maricopa village named Secate in one of the largest battles in Arizona's history. It was also the last major battle fought by the Yumas and the last major battle fought solely between Native Americans in North America.

zh.s: 皮马山丘战役又称马里科帕泉战役，于1857年9月1日在亚利桑那州皮马山丘、埃斯特雷亚山脉马里科帕泉附近打响。尤马人、莫哈维人、阿帕奇人和亚瓦派人袭击了名为塞卡特的马里科帕村庄，这是亚利桑那历史上规模最大的战役之一。它也是尤马人参加的最后一场重大战役，也是北美原住民之间最后一场大型战役。

en.s: The 1857 Vermont gubernatorial election for governor of Vermont was held on Tuesday, September 1. In keeping with the "Mountain Rule", incumbent Republican Ryland Fletcher was a candidate for a second one-year term. The Democratic nominee was Henry Keyes, a former member of the Vermont House of Representatives and Vermont Senate who had run against Fletcher in 1856.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州州长选举于1857年9月1日星期二举行。按照“山地规则”，现任共和党州长莱兰·弗莱彻竞选第二个一年任期。民主党候选人亨利·凯斯曾任佛蒙特州众议院和州参议院议员，并在1856年与弗莱彻竞争过。

en.s: The Battle of Four Lakes was a battle during the Coeur d'Alene War of 1858 in the Washington Territory (now the states of Washington and Idaho) in the United States. The Coeur d'Alene War was part of the Yakima War, which began in 1855. The battle was fought near present-day Four Lakes, Washington, between elements of the United States Army and a coalition of Native American tribes consisting of Schitsu'umsh (Coeur d'Alene), Palus, Spokan, and Yakama warriors.

zh.s: 四湖战役是1858年科达伦战争中的一场战斗，发生在美国华盛顿领地（今华盛顿州和爱达荷州）。科达伦战争是1855年开始的雅基马战争的一部分。战斗在今华盛顿州四湖镇附近进行，交战双方为美国陆军部队和一个由原住民部族组成的联盟，成员包括施齐楚姆什人（科达伦人）、帕卢斯人、斯波坎人和雅卡马人。

en.s: The siege of Tourane (September 1858–March 1860) was a Vietnamese victory during the Cochinchina campaign, a punitive campaign against the Vietnamese launched by France and Spain in 1858. A joint Franco-Spanish expedition under the command of Admiral Charles Rigault de Genouilly captured Tourane (modern Da Nang) in September 1858, but was then besieged in the city by the Vietnamese and forced eventually to evacuate it in March 1860.

zh.s: 土伦围城战（1858年9月至1860年3月）是交趾支那战役中的一次越南胜利。交趾支那战役是法国和西班牙于1858年发动的对越惩罚性军事行动。查尔斯·里戈·德·热努伊海军上将率领的法西联军于1858年9月攻占土伦（今岘港），随后被越南军队围困在城中，最终于1860年3月被迫撤离。

en.s: The Cochinchina campaign was a series of military operations between 1858 and 1862, launched by a joint naval expedition force on behalf of the French Empire and the Kingdom of Spain against the Nguyễn period Vietnamese state. It was the opening conflict of the French conquest of Vietnam.

en.t: French and Spanish forces attack Da Nang, opening their Vietnam campaign
en.s: On September 1, 1858, a combined French and Spanish force attacked Da Nang on the coast of Đại Nam, beginning the military campaign that led to France’s conquest of Vietnam. The attackers opened fire and landed at the Sơn Trà peninsula. Nguyễn forces and local residents resisted, and the fighting at Da Nang continued long after the opening day.
en.n: The dated event is the September 1 assault at Da Nang, not the entire 1858–1885 conquest.

zh.t: 法西联军进攻岘港，法国侵越战争开始
zh.s: 1858年9月1日，法国与西班牙联军进攻越南阮朝的岘港，打响了后来法国侵占越南的战争。联军炮击海岸并在山茶半岛登陆，阮朝军民展开抵抗。岘港的战事此后还持续了很长时间，并非当天就结束。
zh.n: 这一天发生的是1858年9月1日对岘港的进攻，而非整个1858至1885年的征服过程。

en.s: The Battle of Britton's Lane occurred September 1, 1862, near the village of Denmark in rural Madison County, Tennessee, during the American Civil War. Ordered to raid north from Mississippi by Maj. Gen. Sterling Price, commanding the Army of the West, thus to prevent Ulysses S. Grant's reinforcing Maj. Gen. Don Carlos Buell in Tennessee, Brig. Gen. Frank C. Armstrong's cavalry brigade struck Col. Elias S. Dennis's Federal force of two cavalry troops, a battery and two infantry regiments. After four hours, in which they suffered heavy losses while taking 213 prisoners, and two field pieces, the raiders withdrew, their mission accomplished.

zh.s: 1862年9月1日，美国内战期间，布里顿巷战役在田纳西州麦迪逊县乡间、丹麦村附近发生。西部军司令斯特林·普赖斯少将奉命从密西西比州向北袭扰，以阻止尤利西斯·格兰特增援田纳西州的唐·卡洛斯·比尔少将。弗兰克·C·阿姆斯特朗准将的骑兵旅袭击了伊莱亚斯·S·丹尼斯上校指挥的联邦军部队，该部队由两个骑兵队、一支炮兵连和两个步兵团组成。战斗持续4小时，袭击部队伤亡惨重，但俘获213人和两门野战炮，随后完成任务撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Chantilly (or Ox Hill, the Confederate name) took place on September 1, 1862, in Fairfax County, Virginia, as the concluding battle of the Northern Virginia Campaign of the American Civil War. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's corps of the Army of Northern Virginia attempted to cut off the line of retreat of the Union Army of Virginia but was attacked by two Union divisions. During the ensuing battle, Union division commanders Isaac Stevens and Philip Kearny were both killed but the Union attack halted Jackson's advance.

zh.s: 尚蒂伊战役又称奥克山战役（南方邦联的称呼），于1862年9月1日在弗吉尼亚州费尔法克斯县进行，是美国内战北弗吉尼亚战役的最后一战。托马斯·J·“石墙”杰克逊率领北弗吉尼亚军团的部队试图切断弗吉尼亚联邦军的退路，却遭两支联邦师部队攻击。随后战斗中，联邦师指挥官艾萨克·史蒂文斯和菲利普·卡尼双双阵亡，但联邦军的进攻阻止了杰克逊继续推进。

en.s: The Battle of Devil's Backbone (also known as Backbone Mountain) was a battle of the American Civil War on September 1, 1863 in Sebastian County, Arkansas. Devil's Backbone is a ridge in the Ouachita Mountains. The Union victory at Devil's Backbone secured the North's capture of Fort Smith (Sebastian County) on September 1, 1863. Although fighting continued in the region, Fort Smith remained a Union base until the war's end.

zh.s: 魔鬼脊战役又称脊骨山战役，是美国内战期间于1863年9月1日在阿肯色州塞巴斯蒂安县进行的一场战斗。魔鬼脊是一处位于沃希托山脉的山脊。联邦军在此获胜后，北方军得以攻占塞巴斯蒂安县的史密斯堡。当地战事此后仍在继续，但史密斯堡一直是联邦军基地，直至内战结束。

en.s: The 1863 Vermont gubernatorial election for governor of Vermont took place on September 1. In accordance with the Republican Party's "Mountain Rule", incumbent Frederick Holbrook was not a candidate for reelection. The Republican nominee was J. Gregory Smith, the Speaker of the Vermont House of Representatives. The Democratic nominee was Timothy P. Redfield, a former member of the Vermont Senate and the Free Soil Party's nominee for governor in 1851.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州州长选举于1863年9月1日举行。按照共和党的“山地规则”，现任州长弗雷德里克·霍尔布鲁克没有竞选连任。共和党候选人是佛蒙特州众议院议长J·格雷戈里·史密斯；民主党候选人是前州参议员蒂莫西·P·雷德菲尔德，他曾于1851年代表自由土地党竞选州长。

en.s: The Battle of Jonesborough (August 31 – September 1, 1864) was fought between Union Army forces led by William Tecumseh Sherman and Confederate forces under William J. Hardee during the Atlanta campaign in the American Civil War. On the first day, on orders from Army of Tennessee commander John Bell Hood, Hardee's troops attacked the Federals and were repulsed with heavy losses.
en.n: American Civil War: The Battle of Jonesborough, alongside the overall Atlanta campaign, culminates in a Union victory for General William T. Sherman as Confederate General John Bell Hood orders the evacuation of Atlanta.

zh.s: 琼斯伯勒战役于1864年8月31日至9月1日举行，是美国内战亚特兰大战役的一部分。威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼率领联邦军，威廉·J·哈迪率领邦联军。首日，哈迪部队奉田纳西军团指挥官约翰·贝尔·胡德之命进攻联邦军，遭到击退并损失惨重。
zh.n: 美国内战：琼斯伯勒战役与整个亚特兰大战役以联邦军威廉·T·谢尔曼将军获胜告终；邦联军约翰·贝尔·胡德将军下令撤出亚特兰大。

en.s: The Battle of Bazeilles was fought on 1 September 1870 during the Franco-Prussian War as a portion of the larger Battle of Sedan and was one of the first battles to feature modern urban warfare tactics. It took place in Bazeilles, France, a small village in the department of Ardennes near Sedan, and involved a force of Bavarian soldiers battling against French marines and partisans. The battle was, in effect, an ambush of the Bavarians (who were allies of the Prussians), by a small detachment of the "Blue Division" Troupes de marine (known also as marsouins), under the command of General de Vassoigne.

zh.s: 1870年9月1日，普法战争期间，巴泽耶战役作为更大规模的色当战役的一部分进行，是最早采用现代城市战术的战斗之一。战场位于法国阿登省色当附近的小村巴泽耶，巴伐利亚士兵与法国海军陆战队和游击队交战。战斗实际上是一次伏击：指挥官德·瓦苏瓦涅将军率领的“蓝色师”海军陆战队小分队（又称marsouins）伏击了作为普军盟友的巴伐利亚军。

en.s: The Battle of Sedan was fought during the Franco–Prussian War on 1 September 1870. It resulted in the capture of Emperor Napoleon III and large numbers of his troops and for all intents and purposes decided the war in favour of Prussia and its allies, though fighting continued under a new French government. The 120,000 strong French Army of Châlons, commanded by Marshal Patrice de MacMahon and accompanied by Napoleon III, was attempting to lift the Siege of Metz, only to be caught by the Prussian Meuse Army and defeated at the Battle of Beaumont.

zh.s: 1870年9月1日，普法战争期间发生色当战役。普军及其盟友俘获拿破仑三世和大批法军，基本决定了战争以普方获胜告终，尽管新成立的法国政府随后继续作战。由帕特里斯·德·麦克马洪元帅指挥、拿破仑三世随行的12万沙隆军原本试图解除梅斯围城，结果遭普军默兹军团截击，并在博蒙战役中被击败。

en.s: The Battle of Noisseville on 31 August 1870 was fought during the Franco-Prussian War and ended in a Prussian victory. Traveling from Metz, the French forces under Marshal François Achille Bazaine attempted to break through the investing line of the Prussian forces under Prince Frederick Charles. At first, the French had slight success, and maintained the ground they won during the day.

zh.s: 努瓦瑟维尔战役发生于1870年8月31日，是普法战争期间的一场战斗，最终以普鲁士获胜告终。法国军队由弗朗索瓦·阿希尔·巴赞元帅率领，从梅斯出发，试图突破普鲁士军队的包围线；普军由弗雷德里克·查尔斯亲王率领。法军起初略占上风，并守住了当天攻下的阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Orange Walk took place on 1 September 1872 when a force of Icaiche Maya led by Marcus Canul attacked the town of Orange Walk in Belize. Canul had previously been involved in conflict with the British authorities over infringements of his people's land rights and non-payment of rent and one motive for the raid may have been to seize the district magistrate for ransom.

zh.s: 1872年9月1日，马库斯·卡努尔率领一支伊卡伊切玛雅人部队袭击伯利兹的奥兰治沃克镇。此前，卡努尔曾因英国当局侵犯其族人的土地权利、拖欠租金等问题与英方发生冲突。这次袭击的一个动机可能是绑架地区治安法官并索要赎金。

en.s: The Battle of Kandahar, 1 September 1880, was the last major conflict of the Second Anglo-Afghan War. The battle in southern Afghanistan was fought between the British forces under command of General Roberts and the Afghan forces led by Ayub Khan. It ended with a decisive British victory over Afghan forces. en.s: The bombing of Wieluń refers to air raids on the Polish town of Wieluń by the German Luftwaffe on 1 September 1939. The Luftwaffe started bombing Wieluń at 04:40, five minutes before the shelling of Westerplatte, which has traditionally been considered the beginning of World War II. The air raid on the town was one of the first aerial bombings of the war. It killed an estimated 1,300 civilians, injured hundreds more and destroyed 90 per cent of the town centre. There were no military targets of any importance in the area. The casualty rate was more than twice as high as Guernica.

zh.s: 1939年9月1日，德国空军轰炸了波兰小镇维隆。空袭于凌晨4时40分开始，比被传统上视为第二次世界大战开端的韦斯特普拉特炮击早5分钟。这是战争中最早的空袭之一，估计造成1,300名平民死亡、数百人受伤，并摧毁镇中心90%的建筑。当地没有重要军事目标。此次空袭的伤亡率是格尔尼卡轰炸的两倍多。

en.s: The Invasion of Poland, also known as the September Campaign, or the 1939 Defensive War in Poland (Polish: Kampania wrześniowa or Wojna obronna 1939 roku), and alternatively the Poland Campaign (German: Polenfeldzug) or Fall Weiss in Germany (Case White), was a joint invasion of Poland by Nazi Germany, the Free City of Danzig, the Soviet Union, and a small Slovak contingent, that marked the beginning of World War II in Europe. The German invasion began on 1 September 1939, one week after the signing of the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, while the Soviet invasion commenced on 17 September following the Molotov-Tōgō agreement that terminated the Russian and Japanese hostilities in the east on 16 September.

zh.s: 波兰战役又称九月战役、波兰1939年防御战，或在德国称为“白色方案”，是纳粹德国、但泽自由市、苏联和一小支斯洛伐克部队联合入侵波兰的军事行动，标志着第二次世界大战在欧洲爆发。德国于1939年9月1日入侵，比《莫洛托夫—里宾特洛甫条约》签署晚一周；苏联则于9月17日入侵，此前苏日之间的《莫洛托夫—东乡协定》于9月16日结束了双方在东部的敌对行动。

en.s: The Battle of Chojnice occurred during the 1939 German invasion of Poland on the first day of the hostilities, 1 September. A detached unit from the Polish army Chojnice Detached Group under Colonel Kazimierz Tadeusz Majewski, part of the Czersk Operational Group under Stanisław Grzmot-Skotnicki, was assigned the task of defending the city of Chojnice, a major regional communications center, against the advancing German 20th Motorized Infantry Division in order to protect the southern flank of Army Pomorze.

zh.s: 霍伊尼采战役发生于1939年德国入侵波兰的第一天，即9月1日。波兰军队霍伊尼采独立支队由卡齐米日·塔德乌什·马耶夫斯基上校指挥，隶属斯坦尼斯瓦夫·格尔莫特-斯科特尼茨基率领的切尔斯克作战集群，奉命抵御推进中的德国第20摩托化步兵师，守卫地区重要交通枢纽霍伊尼采，并保护波莫热集团军的南翼。

en.s: The "7th" annual (void) Venice International Film Festival was held from 8 August to 1 September 1939. This edition has been strongly influenced by the Fascist regime and was deserted by the United States of America. The Mussolini Cup was won by the historical film Cardinal Messias, while the other main prizes were not awarded.

en.t: Defence of the Polish Post Office in Danzig
en.s: The Defence of the Polish Post Office in Gdańsk (Danzig) was one of the first acts of World War II in Europe, as part of the September Campaign. On 1 September 1939 the Invasion of Poland was initiated by Germany when the battleship Schleswig-Holstein opened fire on the Polish-controlled harbor of Danzig, around 04:45.

zh.s: 但泽（格但斯克）波兰邮局保卫战是第二次世界大战在欧洲最早发生的事件之一，属于波兰战役的一部分。1939年9月1日约4时45分，德国战舰石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因号向由波兰控制的但泽港开火，德国由此发动入侵波兰。

en.s: The charge at Krojanty, battle of Krojanty, the riding of Krojanty or skirmish of Krojanty was a Polish cavalry charge on the evening of 1 September 1939, the first day of the Second World War, near the Pomeranian village of Krojanty. It occurred at the start of the invasion of Poland and was part of the larger Battle of Tuchola Forest.

zh.s: 克罗扬蒂骑兵冲锋又称克罗扬蒂战役、克罗扬蒂骑行或克罗扬蒂遭遇战，于1939年9月1日晚发生在波美拉尼亚克罗扬蒂村附近，是第二次世界大战爆发首日的战斗。该战斗发生于德国入侵波兰之初，是图霍拉森林战役的一部分。

en.s: The Danzig crisis was an important prelude to World War II. The crisis lasted from March 1939 until the outbreak of war on 1 September 1939. The crisis began when tensions escalated between Nazi Germany and the Second Polish Republic over the Free City of Danzig (present-day Gdańsk, Poland). The city, since the early 14th century largely German-speaking, had been ruled variously by Polish and German authorities in its long history.

zh.s: 但泽危机是第二次世界大战的重要前奏，持续时间为1939年3月至同年9月1日战争爆发。纳粹德国与波兰第二共和国围绕但泽自由市（今波兰格但斯克）的紧张关系升级，引发危机。这座城市自14世纪初起以德语人口为主，历史上曾由波兰和德国当局交替管辖。

en.s: The 1940 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was a hurling match played at Croke Park on 1 September 1940 to determine the winners of the 1940 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champions of the three hurling provinces of Ireland. It was the 53rd All-Ireland final. The match was contested by Kilkenny of Leinster and Limerick of Munster, with Limerick winning by 3–7 to 1–7.

zh.t: 1940年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1940年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛于1940年9月1日在克罗克公园举行，决定当年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛的冠军。这项赛事由盖尔运动协会组织，参赛者为爱尔兰三个曲棍球省份的冠军队。这是第53届全爱尔兰决赛，由伦斯特的基尔肯尼对阵芒斯特的利默里克，利默里克以3比7获胜，基尔肯尼得1比7。

en.t: Bombing of Königsberg in World War II
en.s: The bombing of Königsberg was a series of attacks made on the city of Königsberg in East Prussia during World War II. The Soviet Air Force had made several raids on the city since 1941. Extensive attacks carried out by RAF Bomber Command destroyed most of the city's historic quarters in the summer of 1944. Königsberg was also heavily bombed during the Battle of Königsberg, in the final weeks of the war.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战期间对柯尼斯堡的轰炸
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，柯尼斯堡遭到一系列空袭。自1941年以来，苏联空军曾多次袭击这座东普鲁士城市。1944年夏，英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部发动大规模空袭，摧毁了该市大部分历史街区。柯尼斯堡在战争最后几周的柯尼斯堡战役期间也遭到猛烈轰炸。

en.s: The Battle of Porlampi, also known as the Battle of Porlammi, was a military engagement fought between the Finnish Army and Red Army from 30 August to 1 September 1941 on the Karelian Isthmus. The battle was fought near the town of Porlampi during the second month of the Continuation War. The battle was a Finnish victory and effectively ended the reconquest of Karelia.

en.s: The Battle of Vyborg was a significant battle during the Finnish invasion of the Karelian Isthmus, part of the Continuation War. The battle took place from August 21 to September 1 where Finland aimed to recapture the city of Vyborg from Soviet control. The battle ended in the Finnish recapture of Vyborg and surrounding areas.

en.s: Operation Ratweek was a series of coordinated attacks on the Axis forces' communication lines in the Balkans during World War II. Launched on 1 September 1944. the attack was led by the combined operations units of the Yugoslav Partisans, Land Forces Adriatic, the heavy bombers of the U.S. 15th Air Force and the light and medium bombers of the Balkan Air Force.

zh.s: 老鼠周行动是第二次世界大战期间，在巴尔干地区针对轴心国军队通信线路展开的一系列协同袭击。行动于1944年9月1日开始，由南斯拉夫游击队、亚得里亚海陆军部队、美国第15航空队的重型轰炸机，以及巴尔干空军的轻型和中型轰炸机协同实施。

zh.s: 1946年全爱尔兰高级组爱尔兰式曲棍球锦标赛决赛是第59届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1946年全爱尔兰高级组爱尔兰式曲棍球锦标赛的最终比赛。这项锦标赛由爱尔兰各郡的顶尖球队参加。比赛于1946年9月1日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，对阵双方是基尔肯尼和科克。伦斯特冠军基尔肯尼以7比5对3比8的比分负于芒斯特冠军科克。

zh.s: 第10届威尼斯国际电影节于1949年8月11日至9月1日举行。电影节永久迁回威尼斯利多岛的电影宫。竞赛单元最佳影片奖更名为“圣马可金狮奖”，名称取自圣马可飞狮，这是威尼斯共和国最著名的象征之一。

en.s: The 1951 New Zealand general election was a nationwide vote to determine the shape of the New Zealand Parliament's 30th term. The First National Government was re-elected, with the National Party increasing its parliamentary majority over the opposition Labour Party. This was the last time until the 2020 election that a party was elected to majority government of New Zealand by receiving a majority of the vote.

zh.s: 新西兰于1951年举行全国大选，选出新西兰议会第30届任期的组成。第一届国家党政府连任，国家党扩大了对反对党工党的议会多数优势。这也是此后直到2020年，最后一次有政党通过获得普选票过半数而在新西兰赢得多数政府席位。

en.t: Australia, New Zealand and the United States sign the ANZUS Treaty
en.s: On September 1, 1951, representatives of Australia, New Zealand and the United States signed their tripartite security treaty at the Presidio of San Francisco. The pact established a framework for consultation and mutual security in the Pacific. It entered into force on April 29, 1952, after the three governments completed ratification.
en.n: The treaty was signed on September 1, 1951, in San Francisco; it entered into force on April 29, 1952.

zh.t: 澳大利亚、新西兰和美国签署《澳新美安全条约》
zh.s: 1951年9月1日，澳大利亚、新西兰和美国的代表在旧金山要塞签署三方安全条约，即《澳新美安全条约》。条约为三国就太平洋地区的安全问题磋商与合作建立了框架。三国完成批准程序后，条约于1952年4月29日生效。

en.s: The 1957 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 70th All-Ireland Final and marked the culmination of the 1957 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 1 September 1957, between Kilkenny and Waterford. The Munster champions lost to their Leinster opponents on a score line of 4–10 to 3–12.

zh.t: 1957年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛

en.t: Iceland extends its fishing limit, beginning the first Cod War
en.s: On September 1, 1958, Iceland extended its exclusive fishing limit from four to twelve nautical miles. Britain rejected the unilateral change, and British trawlers continued to fish in the disputed zone under Royal Navy protection. The confrontation opened the first of the fishing disputes later known as the Cod Wars.
en.n: The September 1, 1958 fishing-limit change began the first Cod War; the name also covers later disputes.

zh.t: 冰岛扩大捕鱼界限，第一次鳕鱼战争开始
zh.s: 1958年9月1日，冰岛把专属捕鱼界限从4海里扩大到12海里。英国不承认这项单方面决定，英国拖网渔船继续在争议水域作业，并由皇家海军护航。这场对峙拉开了第一次鳕鱼战争的序幕。
zh.n: 1958年9月1日的捕鱼界限调整引发第一次鳕鱼战争；“鳕鱼战争”也包括后来几轮争端。

en.s: The 1959 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on September 1, 1959. The governing Liberals of Premier Alex W. Matheson were defeated by the Progressive Conservatives led by Walter R. Shaw, who gained a massive number of districts across the Island to earn a majority government, despite a close result in the popular vote.

zh.s: 加拿大爱德华王子岛省于1959年9月1日举行大选。省长亚历克斯·W·马西森领导的执政自由党败给沃尔特·R·肖领导的进步保守党。进步保守党在全岛多个选区大幅领先并赢得多数席位，尽管普选票差距不大。

en.s: TWA Flight 529 was a Lockheed Constellation L-049 propliner, registration N86511, operating as a scheduled passenger service from Boston, Massachusetts to Los Angeles, California. On September 1, 1961, at 02:05 CDT, the flight crashed into a field south of Clarendon Hills, Illinois shortly after takeoff from Midway Airport (ICAO: KMDW) in Chicago, killing all 73 passengers and five crew on board; it was at the time the deadliest single plane disaster in U.S. history.

zh.s: 环球航空529号班机是一架洛克希德星座L-049型客机，注册号N86511，当时执行从马萨诸塞州波士顿飞往加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的定期客运航班。1961年9月1日凌晨2时05分（美国中部夏令时），飞机从芝加哥中途机场（ICAO代码：KMDW）起飞后不久，在伊利诺伊州克拉伦登希尔斯以南坠入一处田野，机上73名乘客和5名机组人员全部遇难。当时这是美国死亡人数最多的单机空难。

en.s: The Battle of Adal took place on 1 September 1961, and was the first battle in the Eritrean War of Independence. In the battle, the Eritrean Liberation Front, which numbered at only 14, was able to overcome the local Ethiopian forces. Rebel weaponry included 1 British and 3 old Italian guns, while the majority of Rebels were unarmed.

zh.s: 阿达尔战役于1961年9月1日发生，是厄立特里亚独立战争中的首场战斗。人数仅有14人的厄立特里亚解放阵线击败了当地埃塞俄比亚部队。反叛者的武器包括1门英国火炮和3门旧意大利火炮，而大多数反叛者没有武器。

en.s: The Eritrean War of Independence (Tigrinya: ውግእ ሰውራ ኤርትራ) was an armed conflict and insurgency aimed at achieving self-determination and independence for Eritrea from Ethiopian rule. Starting in 1961, Eritrean insurgents engaged in guerrilla warfare to liberate Eritrea Province from the rule of the Ethiopian Empire under Haile Selassie and later the Derg under Mengistu Haile Mariam. Their efforts ultimately succeeded in 1991 with the fall of the Derg regime.

zh.s: 厄立特里亚独立战争（提格利尼亚语：ውግእ ሰውራ ኤርትራ）是一场旨在使厄立特里亚摆脱埃塞俄比亚统治、实现自决和独立的武装冲突与叛乱。自1961年起，厄立特里亚叛军发动游击战，试图将厄立特里亚省从海尔·塞拉西领导的埃塞俄比亚帝国以及后来门格斯图·海尔·马里亚姆领导的德格政权统治下解放出来。1991年德格政权垮台后，厄立特里亚最终实现独立。

en.s: The 1969 Libyan revolution or coup d'état, also known as al-Fateh Revolution or 1 September Revolution, was a coup d'état and revolution carried out by the Free Officers movement, a group of Arab nationalist and Nasserist officers in the Libyan Army, which overthrew the Senussi monarchy of King Idris I and resulted in the formation of the Libyan Arab Republic. The Free Officers movement was led by Colonel Muammar Gaddafi. The government of Idris was increasingly unpopular by the late 1960s due to internal mismanagement, and the rise of Arab nationalist sentiment further weakened his regime. en.s: On 1 September 1981 General André Kolingba deposed David Dacko in a bloodless coup while Dacko was away from the country traveling to an official state visit in Libya. The day after the coup a "Military Committee for National Recovery" (Comite Militaire pour le Redressement National - CMRN) was established and was led by Kolingba. The Committee then suspended the constitution and limited political party activity. Kolingba's military regime promised to hold elections and get rid of corruption but over the next four years corruption increased and the Committee repeatedly pushed back planned elections. In 1982 the regime survived a coup attempt.

en.t: Japanese prime minister Yasuo Fukuda announces his resignation
en.s: On September 1, 2008, Japanese prime minister Yasuo Fukuda announced that he would resign, prompting his Liberal Democratic Party to choose a new leader. Tarō Asō was elected party president on September 22 and became prime minister on September 24. Fukuda remained in office during the transition, so Asō did not succeed him on the day of the announcement.
en.n: Fukuda announced his resignation September 1; Asō became LDP president September 22 and prime minister September 24.

zh.t: 日本首相福田康夫宣布辞职
zh.s: 2008年9月1日，日本首相福田康夫宣布辞职，自民党随后启动新党首选举。麻生太郎在9月22日当选党首，并于9月24日出任首相。福田在交接期间继续担任首相，因此麻生并不是在福田宣布辞职的当天接任。
zh.n: 福田9月1日宣布辞职；麻生9月22日当选自民党党首，9月24日出任首相。

en.t: PlayStation 3 system software 3.00 launches with What’s New
en.s: On September 1, 2009, Sony released PlayStation 3 system software version 3.00 as a downloadable update. It introduced the What’s New screen, which displayed PlayStation news, media and links when users opened the console’s XMB interface. Sony had announced the feature earlier at Gamescom; this was its release date.
en.n: The What’s New feature was announced earlier; PS3 system software 3.00 became available on September 1, 2009.

zh.t: PlayStation 3 系统软件 3.00 上线，加入“最新资讯”功能
zh.s: 2009年9月1日，索尼推出可下载的 PlayStation 3 系统软件 3.00 版。更新加入“What’s New”（最新资讯）页面，用户打开主机的 XMB 界面时，可以看到 PlayStation 的新闻、媒体内容和相关链接。索尼此前已在科隆游戏展公布这项功能，这一天是正式上线。
zh.n: “最新资讯”功能此前已公布；PS3 系统软件 3.00 于2009年9月1日开放下载。

en.s: The CMLL International Gran Prix (2017) was a lucha libre, or professional wrestling, tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council" in Spanish) that took place on September 1, 2017 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, CMLL's main venue. The 2017 International Gran Prix was the thirteenth time CMLL held an International Gran Prix tournament since 1994.

zh.s: 2017年CMLL国际大奖赛是一场自由式摔角（职业摔角）赛事，由墨西哥职业摔角推广组织世界摔角理事会（CMLL，西班牙语名称意为“世界摔角理事会”）策划并编排，于2017年9月1日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，该场馆是CMLL的主要场地。这是CMLL自1994年以来第13次举办国际大奖赛。

en.s: The September 2017 Democratic Party leadership election was held on 1 September 2017 to replace outgoing president Renhō, who resigned in July after the party's failure in the 2017 Tokyo prefectural election. Seiji Maehara, the runner up in the 2016 contest, defeated Yukio Edano by a wide margin. Maehara's success was a victory for the conservative wing of the party, but also precipitated an internal crisis that resulted in a split in the party only a month later.

zh.t: 日本民主党2017年9月党首选举
zh.s: 日本民主党于2017年9月1日举行党首选举，接替已卸任的莲舫。她在该党于2017年东京都议会选举中失利后，于7月辞职。2016年党首选举中排名第二的前原诚司以明显优势击败枝野幸男。前原胜选是党内保守派的一次胜利，但也引发内部危机，导致该党仅一个月后分裂。

en.s: The 2018 All In was an independent professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event promoted by Cody Rhodes and The Young Bucks (Matt Jackson and Nick Jackson) in association with the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH). At the time, Rhodes and the Jacksons had been a part of the Bullet Club of New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and ROH. The event took place during Labor Day weekend on Saturday, September 1, 2018, at the Sears Centre Arena in the Chicago suburb of Hoffman Estates, Illinois.

zh.s: 2018年“All In”是一场独立职业摔角付费点播赛事，由科迪·罗兹和“年轻雄鹿”组合（马特·杰克逊和尼克·杰克逊）主办，并与美国摔角联盟荣誉之环（ROH）合作举办。当时，罗兹和杰克逊兄弟都是新日本职业摔角（NJPW）及ROH旗下子弹俱乐部的成员。赛事于2018年9月1日劳动节周末的星期六，在伊利诺伊州芝加哥近郊霍夫曼庄园市的西尔斯中心体育馆举行。

zh.t: 2018年努瓦克肖特地区议会选举
zh.s: 毛里塔尼亚于2018年9月1日举行地区选举，并于9月15日进行第二轮投票，选出新成立的努瓦克肖特地区委员会37名成员。该委员会是在2017年毛里塔尼亚修宪公投后成立的，取代参议院和努瓦克肖特城市社区。这场选举属于2018年毛里塔尼亚地区选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2019 Saxony state election was held on 1 September 2019 to elect the members of the 7th Landtag of Saxony. The outgoing government was a grand coalition of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and Social Democratic Party (SPD) led by Minister-President Michael Kretschmer. The CDU, SPD, and The Left suffered heavy losses. The Alternative for Germany (AfD) moved into second place with 27.5% of votes, an increase of almost 18 percentage points.

zh.s: 2019年萨克森州州议会选举于2019年9月1日举行，以选出第七届萨克森州议会议员。选举前的政府是由基民盟（CDU）和社会民主党（SPD）组成的大联合政府，由州长米夏埃尔·克雷奇默领导。基民盟、社民党和左翼党都遭遇惨败。德国选择党（AfD）以27.5%的得票率升至第二位，得票率比上次增加了近18个百分点。

en.s: The 2019 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 132nd final of Gaelic football's primary competition, the All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, and the culmination of the 2019 tournament. Reigning title holder Dublin took on Munster champion Kerry, with Dublin bidding to become the first Gaelic Athletic Association (GAA) male team to win five consecutive editions of the competition. The last time a football team had this chance was in 1982; however, Kerry failed, their own winning streak being brought to an end by a last-minute goal. The first game was played at Croke Park in Dublin on 1 September 2019, featuring goals by Jack McCaffrey (top scorer from open play with 1–3) and Killian Spillane and a red card for Jonny Cooper.

zh.t: 2019年全爱尔兰盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2019年全爱尔兰盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛是盖尔式足球顶级赛事全爱尔兰锦标赛的第132届决赛，也是当年赛事的收官之战。卫冕冠军都柏林对阵芒斯特冠军克里，都柏林希望成为首支连续五届夺冠的盖尔运动协会（GAA）男子球队。此前一支球队有望达成这一纪录还是在1982年；不过，克里未能成功，最后时刻的一粒进球终结了他们自己的连胜。首场比赛于2019年9月1日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，杰克·麦卡弗里和基利安·斯皮兰打入进球，乔尼·库珀被罚红牌；麦卡弗里以运动战1球3分成为最高得分手。

en.s: The 2019 Brandenburg state election was held on 1 September 2019 to elect the members of the 7th Landtag of Brandenburg. It took place on the same day as the 2019 Saxony state election. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and The Left, led by Minister-President Dietmar Woidke. zh.s: 勃兰登堡州于2019年9月1日举行州议会选举，选出第七届州议会成员。选举与同日举行的萨克森州选举同时进行。选前，州政府由社会民主党（SPD）和左翼党组成联盟，州长为迪特马尔·沃伊德克。社会民主党、左翼党和在野的基督教民主联盟（CDU）均遭受重大损失。

en.s: The 2021 Thailand Champions Cup was the 5th Thailand Champions Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Thai League 1 and Thai FA Cup competitions. It was sponsored by Daikin, and known as the Daikin Thailand Champions Cup (Thai: ไดกิ้น ไทยแลนด์แชมเปียนส์คัพ) for sponsorship purposes. The match was played on 1 September 2021 at the 700th Anniversary of Chiangmai Stadium in Mae Rim, Chiangmai and contested by 2020–21 Thai League 1 champions BG Pathum United, and Chiangrai United as the champions of the 2020–21 Thai FA Cup.

zh.s: 2021年泰国冠军杯是第5届泰国冠军杯，这项年度足球赛事由上赛季泰超联赛和泰国足总杯的冠军对决。赛事由大金赞助，赞助名称为“大金泰国冠军杯”（泰语：ไดกิ้น ไทยแลนด์แชมเปียนส์คัพ）。比赛于2021年9月1日在清迈府湄林县的清迈700周年纪念体育场举行，对阵双方是2020至21赛季泰超冠军巴吞联和泰国足总杯冠军清莱联。

en.s: The 2022 Bulgarian Supercup was the 19th edition of the Bulgarian Supercup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's First League and the Bulgarian Cup. The game was played between the champions of the 2021–22 First League, Ludogorets Razgrad, and the 2021–22 Bulgarian Cup winners, Levski Sofia. This was Ludogorets's 10th Supercup appearance and Levski Sofia's 5th.

zh.s: 2022年保加利亚超级杯是第19届保加利亚超级杯。这项年度足球赛事由上赛季保加利亚甲级联赛和保加利亚杯冠军对阵。本场比赛由2021至22赛季甲级联赛冠军卢多戈雷茨拉兹格勒对阵保加利亚杯冠军索菲亚列夫斯基。这是卢多戈雷茨第10次参加超级杯，也是索菲亚列夫斯基第5次参加。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Singapore on 1 September 2023. It was the sixth direct presidential election and the third to be contested by more than one candidate. Incumbent president Halimah Yacob, who had been elected unopposed in 2017, did not seek re-election. Three candidates contested the non-partisan position: Tharman Shanmugaratnam, Ng Kok Song and Tan Kin Lian.

zh.s: 新加坡于2023年9月1日举行总统选举。这是该国第六次直接总统选举，也是第三次有多名候选人参选。现任总统哈莉玛·雅各布于2017年自动当选，这次没有寻求连任。三名候选人角逐这一无党派职位：尚达曼、黄国松和陈钦亮。

en.t: Siege of the Argentine Embassy and ambassador's residence in Venezuela
en.s: The siege of the Argentine Embassy in Venezuela was a blockade of the Argentine Embassy and ambassador's residence in Caracas. Movement into and out of the compound was restricted between July 30 to September 1, 2024, on September 7–8, 2024, and from November 23, 2024, to May 6, 2025. The siege was ordered by the government of Nicolás Maduro and is part of the Venezuelan post-electoral crisis.

en.s: General elections were held in Guyana on 1 September 2025. The result was a victory for President Irfaan Ali and the governing People's Progressive Party/Civic, who won 36 seats, an increase of three from the 2020 election. The declaration of the result was made by GECOM on 7 September 2025 at midnight, and Ali was inaugurated later that day.
